verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 104.7 (+5.9% in a day) and momentum is 39: prices are falling. 84s cost 950, 85s 2,700 and 86s 5,200. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-14T17:12:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Buy Esmee Brugts 85 Team of the week after its 27% fall, sell in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 77,000 coins. Now 81,000. Buy the dip: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often recovers part of the fall within two days. Picked because it is down 26.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This is the strategy's first tracked call. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Buy Debinha 87 for the weekend, sell by Friday evening
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 9,400 coins. Now 8,800. Buy before the weekend: meta cards are bought for Champions weekend, so they often rise from midweek to Friday evening. Picked because it is meta rating 91 at CAM for 9,400 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This is the strategy's first tracked call. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-10-15T07:59:00+01:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 950 (1.14 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,700 (1.29 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,200 (1.27 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,900 (1.25 coins per Item Score point), 88s 11,750 (1.42 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 87s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Amaiur Sarriegi and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Amaiur Sarriegi 80 Rare -59.8%; Selma Bacha 86 Rare -56.0%; Theo Hernández 82 Rare -44.3%; Jules Koundé 85 Rare -39.0%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
